meta_title: Barnsley Plumbing & Gas | Gas Engineer Doncaster
meta_description: Barnsley Plumbing & Gas Services offers expert gas engineering, boiler repairs, and heating installations across Doncaster. Same-day emergency callouts available.
hero_subhead: Boiler broken in the middle of winter? We're here same day, any time—diagnose and fix most faults before you know it.
services_heading: Complete Gas & Plumbing Services Across Doncaster
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new installations, we handle every aspect of your heating and hot water system with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repair
services.desc: Boiler won't fire? We diagnose the fault fast and carry most common parts on the van. Most callouts fixed same day, guaranteed.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New Worcester, Ideal, or Viessmann boiler fitted with full system commission and 10-year warranty. We handle the paperwork and building regulations compliance.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Annual gas safety checks and certificates for landlords and letting agents. Comprehensive inspection of all gas appliances and pipework.

services.title: Central Heating System Service
services.desc: Annual maintenance and power flushing to keep your system running efficiently and extend its life. Includes bleed, refill, and pressure check.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Replacements
services.desc: Leaking radiators, cold spots, or noisy pipes? We fix the problem quickly and can install new radiators or upgrade your whole system.

services.title: Landlord Gas Safety Inspections
services.desc: Full compliance checks for multi-unit properties. We issue CP12 certificates and advise on any remedial work needed to meet regulations.

about_pullquote: We started because neighbours were being overcharged by cowboys. Not happening on our watch.
about_para_1: Barnsley Plumbing & Gas Services has been fixing broken boilers and installing new heating systems across Doncaster and South Yorkshire for 18 years. We're Gas Safe Registered, carry full public liability insurance, and take the headache out of emergency callouts. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a planned new boiler, we show up on time, do the job right, and charge what we quote.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on speed, honesty, and no hidden charges. We don't charge just to come out, and we don't upsell work you don't need. Customers call us back because we treat their home with respect, explain what's wrong in plain English, and get the job done properly the first time.
reviews_heading: What Doncaster Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed up on a Sunday morning in November—absolute nightmare timing. Called Barnsley Plumbing at 9am and they were here by 10:30. Found a faulty pump, replaced it, and had the heating back on before lunch. No faffing about, fair price, and they even explained what went wrong without talking down to us. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a gas safety check done for my rental property. The engineer was thorough, checked every appliance, and gave me a clear report with the CP12 certificate the same day. Very professional. Would recommend for any landlord needing compliance work.
reviews.author: Priya M.

reviews.text: Replaced our old boiler with a new Worcester one. From the survey to the installation to commissioning, everything went smoothly. They explained the warranty and left the house clean. Three years on and it's running perfectly. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David K.
